test_VASP_cleanup: test the _clean_up_inputs function to verify kpts are computed and added to VASP flags
test_unique_kpts: test that _clean_up_inputs generates unique kpts for different adsorbate-slab atom configurations
test_AdsorbateSlabConfig: test AdsorbateSlabConfig creation with Bulk, Slab, and Adsorbate samples from the database
test_Slab_from_bulk: test Slab.from_bulk_get_random_slab to generate random slab configurations from a Bulk object
test_VASP_flags_mutation: test that _clean_up_inputs does not mutate the original VASP_FLAGS dictionary
